reason: The hexagonal cell (a=5.8042 A, c=4.9320 A) and Z=2 are strongly established by 26 indexed reflections (M26=180.7), and the P63/mmc Ba-2d/Mn-2a/O-6h model reproduces the full profile with an unweighted relative residual of about 0.039 and RMS 0.143, close to the pattern noise/profile-model limit. The CIF round-trips to fully occupied BaMnO3 and has physically plausible Mn-O (1.925 A), Mn-Mn (2.466 A), and Ba-O coordination. Intensities strongly reject the only direct Ba/Mn ordering swap (relative residual about 0.84). Although no standardized comparable Rwp was supplied and the trace did not broadly enumerate subgroups, the reflection absences support the submitted average symmetry, and a scientifically known lower-symmetry 2H P63cm superstructure gives unsupported extra reflections and a worse profile residual in verifier checking. There is therefore no material unresolved discrete ambiguity or plausible alternative likely to improve the candidate set.
